Marta (support): NimbleApps reporting sudden 429s on dedicated-pool-12 after plan change + key rotation at 2026-03-18T03:05Z.
Sam (customer-success): They say reserved throughput unchanged but many calls returning 429. Attached sample curl for repro.
Marta (support): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-nimble-OLD" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
Jordan (infra): Pulled tenant_quotas for nimble org. Two active rate_keys bound to same billing account: nimble-org => 500/min, nimble-org-rot => 50/min. Key rotation created a shadow key that missed quota backfill.
Priya (SRE): That split explains per-key ceilings and burst 429s even though pool has spare capacity. Quick options: merge the small key into primary, or temporarily bump the rotated key. I'll run a non-disruptive merge now.
Jordan (infra): Admin command used locally: `adminctl quota merge --from=nimble-org-rot --to=nimble-org --preserve-usage --reason="rotation-split"`
deploy-bot: quota-merge job started job-id=qm-20260318-77, ETA ~40s
Priya (SRE): Merge complete. New effective quota: nimble-org = 550/min. Autoscaler warmup observed ~20-30s. Error rate dropped from ~1.5% to ~0.2 within 2 minutes, then near 0.
Sam (customer-success): Informed customer we merged quotas; they confirmed 429s subsided. They asked whether the billing upgrade caused this.
Priya (SRE): Root cause: plan-migration flow applied quota to account-level object but skipped orphaned/secondary rate_keys created by key rotation. Mitigations: add quota-backfill step to upgrade pipeline (hotfix PR queued), detect multiple rate_keys and auto-merge or block upgrades until resolved (longer-term).
Marta (support): I'll send a plain-language postmortem and ETA for permanent fix. Thanks team :thumbsup:
